title: Felix and the Orchard
author: Xanthe Oyelaran
blurb: Xanthe Dunmore, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
